text:
Type: tall chest of six drawers
Use: storing clothes, toys and crafts; children's room, playroom, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: white painted board, round plastic knobs
Colors: white, multicolored knobs in green, blue, pink, yellow and orange
Shape: tall narrow box with four shallow and two deep drawers, one round colored knob centered on each, flat top, plinth base, compact and upright
Feel: cheerful, playful, bright, tidy
Goes with: white walls, light wood, colorful toys and textiles; playful Scandinavian children's rooms
